title: Launch ecosystem synchronization calendar and ops checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a single synchronized calendar and operational checklist to coordinate blog, customer email, social, and webinar assets for the Optimize (feature) public announcement. The deliverable will reduce last-minute misalignment, ensure all copy and screenshots match the final build, and provide an on-call routing plan for launch day. This ticket covers planning, asset gating, owner commitments, and a compact risk playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Master announcement calendar published and accessible to all stakeholders by 2026-03-08
Finalized blog post draft (content + hero image) approved by PM and Design and linked in calendar
Customer email sequences (preview + subject lines) uploaded to marketing queue and QA reviewed
Social copy scheduled for primary channels with fallback posts prepared
Webinar date, host, and registration page live; slide deck version 1 uploaded
Runbook for launch day notifications and rollback conditions documented and acknowledged by on-call engineers
milestones: 2026-03-05: Kickoff with Eng/Design/Marketing/Support - align scope and deadlines
2026-03-12: Blog draft v1 -> review cycle complete
owners: PM: Aisha Patel - overall coordinator and content owner

Engineering: Marcus Lee - feature readiness signoff and on-call of record

risks: Last-minute product regression prevents use of promised screenshot flows - mitigation: prepare two screenshot variants and statement for partial availability
Webhook rate limits hit during email test - mitigation: coordinate with infra to whitelist test origin and run scaled dry-run
Resource conflicts for webinar host - mitigation: have DevRel backup and prerecorded intro
Copy drift between blog and release notes - mitigation: single source of truth doc and signoff gate
